title: feat: add selectable KPI time range
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds a 12/20-week selector to the KPI dashboard, with 12 weeks remaining the default
- Persists the 20-week choice in the URL and reloads the existing serial data sources only when the range changes
- Makes Stripe revenue request the same selected window so older columns stay complete
- Tests URL range parsing; KPI tests and production build pass

gist.headline: The dashboard remembers
gist.blurb: The KPI garden can now stretch from 12 to 20 weeks without losing its place. Even the Stripe columns got the memo.
gist.summary: Added a URL-persisted 12/20-week selector to the internal KPI dashboard, keeping 12 weeks as the default and requesting Stripe revenue for the selected window.
gist.impact: Dashboard operators can inspect a complete 20-week history when needed, with existing serial data reloaded only after the selected range changes.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy analytics garden where a retro KPI terminal can switch between 12 and 20 weekly flower beds, with Polli adjusting the range selector and a small Stripe-inspired revenue chart growing to fill the longer view. The visual metaphor is a dashboard remembering its selected horizon through a labeled path sign.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush, light blue wings, and a tiny analyst visor, adjusting a retro CRT KPI dashboard between pixel-font buttons labeled “12 WEEKS” and “20 WEEKS.” A longer row of lime green (#ecf874) chart-flower beds blooms beside a complete little revenue graph, with code-plants and warm cream, mint, lavender, and peach gradients; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful.
